title: Vintage 1967 Bulova Ladies Wristwatch – 10K RGP Bezel, Swiss Made, Manual Wind
descriptionText:
This is a beautiful vintage Bulova women's wristwatch dated to 1967 (M7 stamp on case back). Features a 10K Rolled Gold Plate bezel with a stainless steel back and a classic expansion bracelet. The dial is marked “Swiss” and has elegant gold-tone markers and hands. Compact and stylish, perfect for collectors or vintage fashion lovers.
❗️This watch is untested and being sold as-is. Please assume it may need service or repair.
Features:
Year: 1967 (M7)
Swiss Made
10K R.G.P. Bezel / Stainless Steel Back
Vintage expansion band
Manual wind (mechanical movement – untested)
Condition:
Case and band show light wear consistent with age
Crystal is clear with minor surface wear
Movement condition unknown – sold as-is, no returns
